_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/casting/test_cant_cast_first_turns.py. t_ccft_avenger is Serra Avenger: a 3/3 flier for {W}{W} that can't be cast during its controller's first three turns; t_ccft_flash_avenger is the same with flash, to show the restriction is about the caster's own turns.

cards.name: Test Avenger
cards.oracle_text:
You can't cast Test Avenger during your first, second, or third turns of the game.
Flying, vigilance

cards.name: Test Flash Avenger
cards.oracle_text:
Flash
You can't cast Test Flash Avenger during your first, second, or third turns of the game.
